name: his_sky
conceit: A first-person POV plate looking straight up (never down at the protagonist's own body or face), so the ceiling, the light, and whoever leans into frame carry the whole beat -- feet crossing, a faceless shadow arriving, then the same POV inverted to look down at last from standing height.

anti: scenes that need the viewer to see the protagonist's own face or reaction -- true first-person POV structurally cannot show it
a story with no real vertical or lying-down/standing-up axis to invert

plate_bill.must_contain: first-person view looking straight up at a stone colonnade ceiling with rippling water-reflected light; sandaled feet crossing at the bottom edge, no narrator body visible
first-person view looking up at a colonnade archway; one robed man's silhouette leaning into frame, face lost in backlight and shadow, his shadow falling over the viewer
first-person view looking DOWN from standing eye-level at one's own hands rolling a mat, sandaled feet visible, a distant pool complex below

motion_slots.earned_by: the shadow's arrival (P2) is the only beat with real narrative motion worth a paid clip; the other two stills hold on the $0 camera.

beat_template.hook: feet crossing overhead, trapped at ground level, the passage of time implied only by blur
beat_template.pivot: the shadow arrives, no face, only presence and backlight
beat_template.landing: standing at last, looking down at one's own hands and feet, the pool small and far below

score_shape: close, breath-level and confined under the ceiling-and-feet hook, a single low held note as the faceless shadow arrives, opening into daylight and space on the standing landing.
